reaction: Seeing the different components together made their transport roles clearer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the picture showed that it can both attach to haemoglobin and be released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the red cells to plasma was straightforward but felt like an intermediate assembly step; the next empty outlines gave away the remaining pairing.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the mature red cells shown had no nuclei, even though the developing cells did.

arbitrary.text: No pairing felt arbitrary, though the final result named defenders and leak-sealing parts without explaining how they work.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the pictures made the connections between blood components and their jobs understandable, and I would be curious to see where the blood goes next.
